# Google Confidential Space root

Used by `tests/test_enclave_gcp.py`. Do not edit this file.

| File | What | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `confidential_space_root.crt` | The Confidential Space Root CA (PEM; SHA-1 fingerprint `B9:51:20:74:2C:24:E3:AA:34:04:2E:1C:3B:A3:AA:D2:8B:21:23:21`, as Google's page gives it) | `https://confidentialcomputing.googleapis.com/.well-known/confidential_space_root.crt` (fetched 2026-11-27) |

Google publishes no signed sample PKI token, so the tests use a fake root
for tokens (`tests/gcpkit.py`) and check only that the pin is this file.
A real token comes from the platform spike.
